answer: Let a falcon circle above the market: a rotating patrol of established agents that dives on any cluster of fresh identities moving in lockstep, exposing the flock before it feeds. Around the shared oasis of paid work, place an onyx gate - a badge earned only through months of countersigned deliveries, impossible to mint overnight. Clones can copy a face, but they cannot copy the slow flight path that earned the badge, so the oasis stays for the proven.
